0022600126.text: The Jazz (1-2, 1-1 at home, on a one-game losing streak) host the 2-0 Grizzlies in what is Utah's fourth game of the season, with Memphis sitting 0.5 games back in the Southwest and Utah 1.5 games back in the Northwest. Utah trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 123-103 in Memphis, while the two teams split their four meetings in 2025-26. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Memphis is missing Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle).
